title: Daily Dose #366: Power to Be His Witness
body:
**“You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses.”**

Just before returning to the Father, Jesus told His disciples they would be His witnesses. He did not send them alone. The Holy Spirit would give them power.

A witness tells what they know to be true. Christians are not called to win every argument, act superior or pressure people into pretending belief. They are called to speak honestly about who Jesus is, what He has done and the hope found in Him.

That can feel intimidating. You may worry about difficult questions or saying the wrong thing. Preparation matters, but the mission has never depended on perfect personalities. Peter once denied knowing Jesus; later, empowered by the Spirit, he spoke about Him openly.

Begin simply. Know the message of the gospel. Know your own story without making yourself the hero. Listen to the person in front of you. Speak with courage and respect.

The Holy Spirit’s power is not given so we can appear impressive. It is given so Jesus can be made known.
